keywords: EF 推出以太坊审计补贴
ERC-8231 后量子密钥注册表
EIP-8188 记录账户与存储槽最后写入区块
Scroll 决定引发 rollup 安全阶段争论
summary: 以太坊基金会与审计机构联合推出以太坊审计补贴，降低构建者的审计成本。Magicians 上提出 ERC-8231，为 NIST 标准化的后量子密钥定义链上注册、轮换、吊销与迁移接口。EIP-8188 讨论帖开设，为每个账户和存储槽记录最后写入的区块号，作为冷热状态分离的第一步。Native Account Abstraction 第一次分组会议议程发布。

keywords_en: EF launches the Ethereum Audit Subsidy
EIP-8188 records the last written block for accounts and slots
Scroll decision sparks a rollup stage debate
summary_en: The Ethereum Foundation and audit providers launched the Ethereum Audit Subsidy to lower audit costs for builders. ERC-8231 was proposed on Magicians, defining onchain registration, rotation, revocation and migration of NIST standardized post-quantum keys. A discussion thread opened for EIP-8188, which records the block number of the last write to every account and storage slot as a first step toward hot and cold state separation. The agenda for the first Native Account Abstraction breakout was posted.
